summary: Pushover is a REST API for sending push notifications to users' devices. You register an application to get a token, then POST messages to a user or group key. It also offers receipts and callbacks for emergency-priority messages, plus subscription, groups, glances, teams, licensing and open-client APIs.

value.description: Application API token sent as the 'token' body parameter, together with a 'user' key (user or group) on message requests.

value.purpose: Send a notification to a user, group or devices

keyParams.name: user
keyParams.description: User or group key; comma-separated list up to 50 users

value.description: If a callback URL is given on an emergency message, Pushover POSTs receipt, acknowledged, acknowledged_at, acknowledged_by and acknowledged_by_device. It retries after one minute if no 2xx is returned.

risks.title: Secrets in query string
risks.detail: Receipt polling puts the app token in the URL query, where it can end up in logs.
